scripts.text:
[Local Villager]
Have you finished hunting the 50 Demon Pungus?
scripts.translation:

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text: I want to quit
scripts.translation: 我想放弃

scripts.text:
[Local Villager]
Remember, I need help hunting Demon Pungus so go and hunt 50 of them.
scripts.translation:

记住，我需要你帮忙猎杀天邪鬼，去杀够50只吧。

scripts.text:
[Local Villager]
Are you sure that you want to stop hunting?
Any progress that you've made will be erased
scripts.translation:
[当地村民]
确定要放弃狩猎吗？
目前的任务进度都会清除。

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Local Villager]
Ok then, well come back here if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[当地村民]
好吧，改变主意了就回来找我。
